faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating English to Spanish.

items.q: Can it translate spoken English into Spanish?
items.a: Yes — tap the mic, speak in English, and you'll get a Spanish translation as text, with an option to hear it read aloud.

items.q: Does it handle Spanish accents and punctuation correctly?
items.a: Yes, accented letters like á, é, í, ó, ú and ñ are handled correctly in what you read and what gets spoken aloud.

items.q: Can I translate from Spanish back to English?
items.a: Yes, the same conversation works both ways — speak or type in Spanish and get the English translation in the same conversation.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No, it runs in your browser on desktop or mobile — nothing to download.

items.q: Can I keep a running conversation instead of one-off translations?
items.a: Yes, each language pair keeps its own history, so a conversation stays together instead of scattering across separate translations.
